decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: This repair restores the established README contract; it does not create or change the exported API or supported contract.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: The task writes Go implementation and test code, so idiomatic Go style and verification guidance apply.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No interface, dependency, constructor, option, wiring, or resource lifecycle changes.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing package, responsibility, ownership, and imports remain unchanged.

decisions.name: go-test-isolation
decisions.reason: Clamp is a pure deterministic calculation. The ordinary regression test uses local inputs and assertions without I/O, doubles, shared state, goroutines, timers, fixtures, or parallel execution.
